recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast male portrait with dark curly hair and a beard, set against a split background of solid black and a blue halftone grid. The layout features a stacked typographic lockup in the top-left corner consisting of a heavy chrome-effect display title and a fluid white script subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial crop creates an intimate, direct gaze with the viewer
Contrast between the organic texture of the hair/beard and the geometric halftone background
Typographic hierarchy established through weight and material finish (chrome vs. flat white)
Color harmony between the subject's blue eyes and the blue background pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies 80% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one closest to the center, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright chrome logo in the top left, moves down to the eyes, then follows the beard line to the bottom right halftone pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black area in the top left provides a high-contrast foundation for the logo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown tones in the hair and shadows provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue in the halftone pattern and eye color.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Yellow chrome gradients in the primary title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/eyes and the deep shadows of the hair.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones, black, and steel blue

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif for the main title; fluid brush script for the subtitle.
letterConstructionRules: Title: Thick, blocky strokes with rounded corners and integrated flourishes (e.g., a tail extending from the first and last letters).
Subtitle: Continuous monolinear script with sharp entries and exits.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first and last letters of the main title feature elongated, horn-like horizontal extensions.
The script subtitle features a long horizontal underline that connects the words.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy metallic industrial display paired with light, personal-feeling handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded 70s/80s display feel.
Approximates the fluid, casual handwriting of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with dark curly hair and a beard, looking directly at the camera with blue eyes. The lighting should be soft but directional. The background should be split diagonally: solid black on the top left and a blue halftone dot pattern on the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large chrome-beveled display title in the top left corner. Below it, add a white fluid script subtitle with a long horizontal underline.

verificationChecks: Is the chrome effect on the main title visible?
Does the script text have a connecting underline?
Is the halftone pattern restricted to the bottom right?
Is the portrait crop tight enough to focus on the eyes?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome text doesn't look like plastic.
Check that the halftone dots are sharp and geometric.
Verify the script text is legible against the hair texture.
Confirm the eye color matches the background blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight male portrait + 80s chrome display type + script subtitle + halftone background accent.
